title: feat(news): record /models daily and add a weekly community model post
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The 06:00 news run now records the full `/models?reliability=all` catalog in `models/snapshots/` when model entries change, ignoring live health-stat changes and preventing reruns from backdating a snapshot. The Wednesday 14:00 model post now covers official models only; a new Wednesday 14:05 community model post uses the same webhook without role pings or mentions. Both posts compare the recorded catalog against the previous Wednesday rather than saving snapshots themselves, avoiding false additions and removals caused by reliability filtering. The community writer accepts only catalog facts—ID, category, price and its per-image or per-token unit, modalities, capabilities, and paid-only status—not owner-written titles, descriptions, or links. An overwrite run can replace the partial October 14, 2026 snapshot with the full catalog for the October 21 comparison.
